content: GRAPH BETA AUTHORITY DECISION needed before task-dd4ffa0c/task-efc2 can be planned safely. The design says GraphRevisionContent hash covers canonical nodes/edges, repository base tree, parent revision, completion node, policy revision, decomposition budget, and author. Current code has only scheduler GraphSnapshot.graphIdentity (structure only) and core stores an opaque graphContentHash; no full content schema/codec/producer exists. Choose: (A, recommended) land a full canonical GraphRevisionContent contract/producer and bind the durable snapshot to its recomputed hash before graph.get/mutations; or (B) authorize an explicitly non-authoritative structural snapshot projection carrying separate snapshotIdentity and core graphContentHash provenance, which cannot yet drive Foundation execution. Do not equate the two hashes.
